survey: A translucent blue sports water bottle floats in the frame, leaning about 20° to the right. Its main parts are as follows. The body is a contoured cylinder with a waist and a raised wave-shaped grip band across the front. The screw cap sits square on the neck. A short spout rises from the centre of the cap and is seen slightly from above, so its top ellipse shows. A carry loop sticks out from the right side of the cap and faces the camera, as a loop swung toward the viewer would. The water line inside is a gentle curve. The base is rounded, and the inner bottom shows through the plastic. The ellipses for the spout top, cap rim, cap-to-shoulder seam and water line all bow the same way and narrow by similar amounts, so they agree on one camera slightly above the bottle. The grip band wraps around the curved body and follows it. The bottle's long axis is one straight line through the cap and spout. The bottle floats, so there is no ground contact to check.
